goal:
Owner login + web-origin-only API access
WHY: P0-1: API and web are unauthenticated today and the browser calls the API directly (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE); in prod the API must accept only the web service account's Google ID token, and there is no org/IAP so the app must do owner login itself.

SPEC: Web (Next.js, apps/web): POST /api/login takes {username,password} JSON (never query string), verifies against server-only env EVO_OWNER_USER and EVO_OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH (format scrypt$N$r$p$saltHex$hashHex, compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual) with a short in-memory rate limit (429 after 10 fails/10min/IP); on success sets a single session cookie __Host-evoforge-session=base64url(random 256-bit).HMAC(EVO_SESSION_SECRET).expiry (~12h) with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=43200; POST /api/logout clears it; GET /api/me returns 200 {user} or 401. Add /login page; proxy route /api/evoforge/[...path] requires a valid session (else 401) and forwards only allowlisted paths /v1/commands/generate, /v1/objectives, /v1/candidates/review, /v1/gates/evaluate, /v1/runs, /v1/pr/create, /v1/evidence/*, /v1/events/*, /v1/commands/*, /v1/ledger, /v1/ledger/reconcile, /v1/eval/sandbox (else 404), fetching a Google-signed ID token server-side from the metadata server (http://metadata.google.internal, audience=EVO_API_BASE, i.e. API URL) and sending Authorization: Bearer <idtoken>; returns API status/body verbatim, 502 if API unreachable. lib/api.ts base becomes same-origin /api/evoforge (no NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE at runtime). No secret in any NEXT_PUBLIC_* var (build must pass with NEXT_PUBLIC_* unset/empty). API (services/api): when EVO_REQUIRE_ID_TOKEN=1, every /v1/* except GET /healthz requires Authorization: Bearer <Google ID token> with iss accounts.google.com|https://accounts.google.com, aud == EVO_API_URL (fallback EVO_API_AUDIENCE), valid exp/iat/signature via Google certs (cache certs 1h); failures 401 missing/invalid/expired, 403 wrong-aud/wrong-service-account (optional allowlist EVO_WEB_SERVICE_ACCOUNT checked via email claim when present). When 0 (local dev default) behavior unchanged. Tighten CORS: default EVO_WEB_ORIGINS empty (same-origin via proxy only); explicit origins only when set. Status codes: web login 200/401/429, proxy 401/404/502, API 401/403.
Critic constraints (test hooks): (1) services/api/evoforge/auth.py exposes verify_id_token(token: str, audience: str) -> dict claims; it verifies signature (Google certs), exp/iat and iss, raising ValueError (or a subclass) on any failure; the HTTP layer calls it via the module attribute (tests monkeypatch evoforge.auth.verify_id_token) and itself compares aud and the optional EVO_WEB_SERVICE_ACCOUNT email -> 403. Use the official google-auth library for verification (add it to services/api/requirements.txt). (2) Next.js cookies: use the Next.js cookies API with httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite and the __Host- prefix. (3) This is a production service; do not label anything demo.

ACCEPTANCE (your own plan): Login with wrong password -> 401 and no Set-Cookie; right password -> 200 with HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite cookie; cookie is HMAC-bound (tampered value -> proxy 401); timingSafeEqual used (no early-exit string compare).; Proxy without cookie -> 401; with cookie forwards method/body to API with Bearer ID token and returns API status verbatim; non-allowlisted path -> 404; no NEXT_PUBLIC_* secret required (grep NEXT_PUBLIC_ shows only same-origin default).; API with EVO_REQUIRE_ID_TOKEN=1: no token -> 401, wrong-aud token -> 403, valid token (test key) -> 200; GET /healthz stays 200 without token; existing suite passes with EVO_REQUIRE_ID_TOKEN=0.; Credentials never appear in URLs/logs; token/secret values never in responses.
OUT OF SCOPE: GCP IAM/Terraform/IAP/org policy and Secret Manager wiring (Claude, P0-7); PostgreSQL/DB session storage (sessions are stateless HMAC cookies; Codex owns persistence); Multi-user/project membership (owner-only single account)
